FREE-ONLY PLAYBOOK · $0 me poora Monarch system
Trigger: AGENTGO free · WF-07 · VIPER-1 viper-1.3 · 2026-10-27 Rule: koi card nahi, koi credit nahi, koi paid API nahi. Jo free me nahi hota, wo rukta hai — bill nahi banta.


________________


0. Ek line ka jawab
Free me poora system chalta hai: script → 480p clips → 960×1664 upscale → voice → foley → music → lip-sync → mixed master → Drive archive. Ceiling 960×1664 + mixed audio hai. 1080p/2K native, aur "ek prompt me synced dialogue" (Veo-3 style) free me nahi milega — uske liye 24 GB card ya paisa chahiye, aur wo hum nahi karenge.


________________


1. Compute ka poora structure (sab card-free)
#
	Provider
	Kya milta hai
	Quota
	Kaam
	1
	Google Colab free
	1× T4 16 GB
	dynamic (koi fixed number nahi, session kabhi bhi khatam)
	daily render box
	2
	Kaggle Notebooks
	2× T4 (alag-alag 16 GB) ya P100
	~30 GPU h/week, counter account me dikhta hai, 12 h session
	weekly workhorse
	3
	Lightning AI free
	T4/L4
	15 credits/month, Studio har 4 h restart
	emergency reserve
	4
	HF ZeroGPU
	shared Blackwell
	5 min/day
	sirf demo
	5
	Aapka laptop (CPU)
	—
	unlimited
	voice, mix, lanczos, verify, assemble
	

Excluded (jaan-boojh kar): Modal ($30 credit magar card on file chahiye), Replicate (free taste ke baad billing), Colab Pro, MiniMax-H3 API. Yeh list studio/free_compute.json me machine-readable hai.
Hardware ki asli haqeeqat
* T4 = 16 GB, Turing (sm_75) → fp16 haan, bf16/fp8 nahi. Isliye "fp8 model" wale tutorials T4 par chalte hi nahi; LatentSync ko capability[0] >= 7 patch chahiye (warna fp32 → OOM).
* Kaggle ke 2× T4 memory pool nahi karte — 2 card = 2×16 GB alag, 24 GB model nahi chalta.
* Kaggle par P100 sunset ho gaya (Sep 2026) → zyada tar T4×2 milega.

Golden rule: GPU sirf render/upscale/foley ke liye jalo. Mix, verify, assemble, voice (Kokoro) — laptop. Yahi 30 h/week ko 2–3 reels ke liye kaafi banata hai.

3. Ek reel ka poora free flow (copy-paste)
# ---------- laptop (0 GPU minutes) ----------


python3 tools/videogen.py doctor                      # free-only mode ON dikhna chahiye


python3 tools/videogen.py new --id reel-01 --title "Monarch reel 01" --aspect 9:16


# project.json me prompts + vo_text + foley_prompt bharo


python3 tools/videogen.py plan  workflows/current/payload/reel-01/project.json   # $0.00


python3 tools/videogen.py render workflows/current/payload/reel-01/project.json  # queue file banayega


# ---------- Colab ya Kaggle (GPU: clip render) ----------


# MONARCH_T4_FREE_BRIDGE.ipynb -> Runtime T4 -> queue file load karo -> Run all


# mp4s Drive me: 05 · Projects/reel-01/shots/


# ---------- Colab/Kaggle (GPU: audio + upscale) ----------


python3 tools/videogen.py audio   <project>.json      # notebook: vo + foley + bed


python3 tools/videogen.py upscale <project>.json      # notebook: 480 -> 960x1664


# dono notebooks Run all -> Drive me audio/ aur shots/*-2x.mp4


# ---------- laptop (0 GPU minutes) ----------


python3 tools/videogen.py mix     <project>.json --loudnorm


python3 tools/videogen.py verify  <project>.json      # height + audio + md5, warna exit 3


python3 tools/videogen.py assemble <project>.json


python3 tools/videogen.py quota --use kaggle 2.0 --note "reel-01 clips+audio"


# master Drive me: 06 · Masters & Receipts/


Har GPU session ke baad quota --use <provider> <hours> likho — isse pata rehta hai kitna bacha hai. Counter: python3 tools/videogen.py quota.


________________


4. Free-only mode kaise kaam karta hai (guard, advice nahi)
* Default: free_only() == True. Project me route: paid likho, API key ho, tab bhi plan har paid step ko free chain me rewrite kar deta hai — estimate hamesha $0.00.
* plan header: FREE-ONLY ($0 guaranteed); warning: "free-only mode: every paid step is rewritten…".
* render --yes free mode me: FREE-ONLY MODE: no paid step will be submitted — render_h3() call hi nahi hoti.
* Unlock sirf jaan-boojh kar: MONARCH_ALLOW_PAID=1 (env). Ye ek deliberate, visible act hai — galti se nahi hota.
* 10 tests isi guard ko pin karte hain (paid project → $0, H3 kabhi call nahi, quota ledger rollover).


________________


5. Quota khatam? Ye order follow karo
1. Colab session mar gaya → wahi notebook Kaggle me import karo (T4×2) → 30 h/week counter.
2. Kaggle quota khatam → Lightning AI free Studio (15 credits) — sirf hero shots ke liye bachao.
3. Sab khatam → laptop par jo ho sake: Kokoro voice, Lanczos ×2 upscale, mix, assemble (960p tak master ban jayega) — koi render nahi, koi paisa nahi.
4. Naya week (Kaggle Sunday 00:00 UTC reset) → render queue wapas chalu.
5. Kabhi mat karo: naya account banana quota bypass ke liye (TOS violation → account ban, aur ye "free" nahi "fraud" hai).


________________


6. Quality ka free ceiling (imaandari se)
Cheez
	Free me
	Kaise
	480×832 native
	✅
	Wan 2.1 1.3B, T4, 8–25 min/clip
	960×1664
	✅
	Real-ESRGAN ×2 (T4) — sharper, naya detail nahi
	720p native
	⚠️ slow
	Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B fp8+offload on Kaggle T4 (~30–60 min/clip)
	1080p native
	❌
	16 GB card par realistic nahi
	2K
	❌
	paid/24 GB+ only
	Synced dialogue in one pass
	❌
	Ovi 11B = 24 GB; Kandinsky 6 Lite ≈ 22 GiB
	Voice + lipsync + foley + music
	✅
	stems + LatentSync (yeh pro workflow hi hai)
	

Client ko kya bolna hai: "delivery 960×1664, phone-first reels ke liye optimised". 1080p/2K ka wada free me nahi — agar client 1080p maange, wo job paid tier me jayegi, warna decline.

9. Checklist (har reel se pehle)
* doctor → free-only mode ON, Kaggle hours bache hue
* plan → $0.00, koi WARN licence wali line padh li
* GPU sessions short (1–2 h), background tabs band
* quota --use likha har session ke baad
* verify exit 3 nahi (height + audio + md5)
* master Drive me + receipts me md5
* kisi ko 1080p/2K ka wada nahi
